question: How do microwave wattage and cooking time affect reheating leftovers safely?

claims.text: - Know your microwave's wattage. Check inside the door, owner's manual, or manufacturer's website. If your microwave is high wattage (800 watts or more), use the minimum cooking time recommended. If it is low wattage (300–500 watts), use the maximum cooking time recommended. - When reheating, use a food thermometer to make sure that microwaved food reaches 165°F.

citations.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
